update_every.title: Update every
update_every.description: Data collection interval, measured in seconds.

autodetection_retry.title: Detection retry
autodetection_retry.description: Recheck interval in seconds. Zero means no recheck will be scheduled.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Time limit, in seconds, for `nvidia-smi` to return GPU data.

loop_mode.title: Loop mode
loop_mode.description: Keep `nvidia-smi` running and reading GPU data on its own interval (the `-l` option) instead of starting it for every collection.

binary_path.ui:help: If an absolute path is provided, the collector will use it directly; otherwise, it will search for the binary in directories specified in the PATH environment variable.

timeout.ui:help:
In regular mode, this limits each `nvidia-smi` run.

In loop mode, it limits the wait for the first sample after the collector starts; on hosts with several GPUs the first sample can take 5 to 10 seconds. It also sets how late a sample may be: when no new sample arrives within the loop interval plus this timeout, the charts show a gap and `nvidia-smi` is restarted.

loop_mode.ui:help: The loop interval is the data collection frequency, at most 5 seconds. Loop mode is not available on Windows.
